jj.badge.conflict.description: A badge on a jj commit storing unresolved conflicts (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.divergent.description: A badge on a jj commit whose change id names several commits (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.divergentTip.defaultMessage: This change id names more than one commit: refer to this one by its commit id. Combwork never picks one.
jj.badge.divergentTip.description: Tooltip of the divergent badge in jj’s History (HI-2799).

jj.badge.empty.description: A badge on a jj commit with no changes (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.badge.workingCopy.description: A badge on the jj working-copy commit (@) of the project folder (HI-2799). Lower case.

jj.bookmarks.conflict.description: A conflicted jj bookmark (HI-2799): it names several commits ({sides}, short ids).

jj.bookmarks.name.description: A column of jj’s Bookmarks (HI-2799): the name (and remote).

jj.bookmarks.none.description: jj’s Bookmarks section (HI-2799) when there are none.

jj.bookmarks.notInGit.description: A badge on a jj bookmark whose Git branch differs (HI-2799): not exported yet, or Git moved it. Lower case. Keep Git.

jj.bookmarks.note.defaultMessage: Bookmarks are created, moved and pushed with jj itself: Combwork only shows them.
jj.bookmarks.note.description: A note in jj’s Bookmarks section (HI-2799). Keep jj.

jj.bookmarks.target.description: A column of jj’s Bookmarks (HI-2799): the change and commit it names.

jj.compare.ambiguous.defaultMessage: {rev} names {n, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}: pick one by its commit id.
jj.compare.ambiguous.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the id is ambiguous (a divergent change id, or a prefix of several): Combwork never picks one.

jj.compare.bad.defaultMessage: Type a bookmark, a change id or a commit id.
jj.compare.bad.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): a field holds something else (spaces, symbols).

jj.compare.capped.defaultMessage: The diff is long: only its start is shown.
jj.compare.capped.description: Under a jj diff in Compare (HI-2799) cut at its limit.

jj.compare.files.defaultMessage: {n, plural, =0 {No files changed} one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
jj.compare.files.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): how many files differ.

jj.compare.from.description: A field of jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the older revision (a bookmark, change id or commit id).

jj.compare.none.description: jj’s Compare (HI-2799): no revision has that name or id.

jj.compare.pick.description: A button beside one of the commits an ambiguous id names in jj’s Compare (HI-2799): puts its commit id in the field.

jj.compare.to.description: A field of jj’s Compare (HI-2799): the newer revision.

jj.conflicts.files.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# conflicted file} other {# conflicted files}}

jj.conflicts.intro.defaultMessage: jj can keep a conflict in a commit and carry on. These commits store conflicts; resolve them with jj in a terminal (jj resolve).
jj.conflicts.intro.description: The top of jj’s Conflicts section (HI-2799). Keep jj and jj resolve (a command).

jj.conflicts.none.description: jj’s Conflicts section (HI-2799) when there are none.

jj.history.capped.defaultMessage: Only the latest {n, number} are shown.
jj.history.capped.description: Under jj’s History (HI-2799) when there are more commits than shown.

jj.ids.tip.description: Tooltip of a jj commit’s ids (HI-2799): both in full.

jj.integrate.card.description: A passed card in jj’s “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799). {commit} is its reviewed commit (short), {target} the bookmark it goes into.

jj.integrate.contained.description: Under a passed jj card (HI-2799): whether its reviewed work is in its target. Combwork can’t check it yet (a later version records it); never read as not integrated.

jj.integrate.head.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799, option A): cards that passed review, which the user brings into their target themselves.

jj.integrate.how.defaultMessage: For example, then move {target} to the rebased commit with jj bookmark set:
jj.integrate.how.description: Above a jj command suggested to integrate a passed card (HI-2799): rebase it onto its target, then move the target bookmark. Keep jj bookmark set (a command).

jj.integrate.noMerge.defaultMessage: Combwork doesn’t merge under jj: integrate the reviewed work with jj yourself.
jj.integrate.noMerge.description: A note under jj’s “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799, Darren’s decision A). Keep jj.

jj.integrate.none.description: Under “Waiting for you to integrate” (HI-2799) when no card has passed.

jj.ops.absent.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): a bookmark, ref or workspace that didn’t exist (before) or doesn’t any more (after). Lower case.

jj.ops.added.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# commit made} other {# commits made}}: {ids}
jj.ops.added.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): the commits the operation made (or rewrote into), short ids.

jj.ops.by.description: Who ran a jj operation and in which workspace (HI-2800), after its description. {user} is user@host as jj records it.

jj.ops.change.description: One thing a jj operation changed (HI-2800): {what} names it (a bookmark, a Git ref…), {before} and {after} its value (short commit ids, or “none”). Keep the arrow.

jj.ops.command.defaultMessage: Undoing it changes only what it changed. To undo it, run this in the project folder:
jj.ops.command.description: Above the jj command a preview offers (HI-2800). Combwork never runs it itself.

jj.ops.conflicted.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): a bookmark or ref whose target is conflicted; {sides} are its commits, short ids.

jj.ops.copied.description: A notification (HI-2800): the jj undo command was copied.

jj.ops.copy.description: A button beside the jj command of an undo preview (HI-2800): copies it, after checking the repository hasn’t changed since the preview.

jj.ops.did.defaultMessage: What it changed (undoing it puts these back)
jj.ops.did.description: A heading in a jj undo preview (HI-2800): the bookmarks, refs, commits and workspaces the operation changed.

jj.ops.didNothing.defaultMessage: Nothing that undoing it would change.
jj.ops.didNothing.description: A jj undo preview (HI-2800) for an operation that changed nothing.

jj.ops.hidden.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# commit hidden} other {# commits hidden}}: {ids}
jj.ops.hidden.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): the commits the operation hid (abandoned or rewrote), short ids. Undoing it brings them back.

jj.ops.intro.defaultMessage: jj records every command as an operation. Preview one to see what undoing it would change. Combwork changes nothing here: when undoing it would touch nothing else, it gives you the command to run yourself.
jj.ops.intro.description: The top of jj’s Operations section (HI-2800). Keep jj.

jj.ops.kind.bookmark.description: A jj bookmark in an undo preview (HI-2800). {name} is its name.

jj.ops.kind.githead.description: A workspace’s Git HEAD as jj records it, in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). Keep Git HEAD.

jj.ops.kind.gitref.description: A Git ref as jj records it, in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). Keep Git.

jj.ops.kind.head.description: A visible head commit in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). {name} is its short id.

jj.ops.kind.remote.description: A remote in a jj undo preview (HI-2800).

jj.ops.kind.remoteBookmark.description: A remote’s bookmark (and whether it is tracked) in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). Keep the @.

jj.ops.kind.remoteTag.description: A remote’s tag in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). Keep the @.

jj.ops.kind.tag.description: A jj tag in an undo preview (HI-2800).

jj.ops.kind.wc.description: A workspace’s working-copy commit in a jj undo preview (HI-2800). {name} is the workspace.

jj.ops.later.defaultMessage: Later work undoing it would also change
jj.ops.later.description: A heading in a jj undo preview (HI-2800): changes made since the operation that undoing it would touch too.

jj.ops.movedAtCopy.defaultMessage: The repository changed since this preview, so nothing was copied. Here it is again: look at it before copying.
jj.ops.movedAtCopy.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): Copy found the repository changed since the preview; the preview shown is the new one.

jj.ops.noCommand.description: In a jj undo preview (HI-2800): Combwork gives no command, and why ({why}).

jj.ops.none.description: jj’s Operations section (HI-2800) when there are none.

jj.ops.older.description: A button under jj’s operations list (HI-2800): shows the next page of older operations.

jj.ops.preview.description: A button on one jj operation (HI-2800): shows what undoing (reverting) it would change, without changing anything.

jj.ops.previewAt.defaultMessage: A preview at operation {at}. If anything else changes before you run it, preview again: this isn’t a guarantee about a later command.
jj.ops.previewAt.description: Under a jj undo preview’s heading (HI-2800): the preview holds only for the repository as it was at that operation ({at}, a short id). Keep jj.

jj.ops.previewHead.description: The heading of a jj operation’s undo preview (HI-2800). {description} is the operation as jj named it.

jj.ops.previewSnapshot.defaultMessage: Run in the project folder, jj first records any edits you haven’t recorded yet, as its own operation, then undoes this one.
jj.ops.previewSnapshot.description: A note on a jj undo preview and its command (HI-2800): jj snapshots the working copy before the revert, as a separate operation. Keep jj.

jj.ops.refused.bounds.defaultMessage: it changed more than a preview shows.
jj.ops.refused.bounds.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): too many bookmarks, refs or commits to account for.

jj.ops.refused.gitOwn.defaultMessage: it recorded a change made in Git: undoing it changes nothing in Git, and jj would import it again.
jj.ops.refused.gitOwn.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): an import of Git’s refs or a fetch. Keep jj and Git.

jj.ops.refused.heads.defaultMessage: jj’s operation log has more than one head.
jj.ops.refused.heads.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800). Keep jj.

jj.ops.refused.moved.defaultMessage: the repository changed since the preview.
jj.ops.refused.moved.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): a new operation was recorded meanwhile.

jj.ops.refused.nothing.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800).

jj.ops.refused.overlap.defaultMessage: undoing it would also change later work, listed above.
jj.ops.refused.overlap.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800).

jj.ops.refused.parents.defaultMessage: it joins operations that ran at the same time (or is the first one), so undoing it can’t be previewed.
jj.ops.refused.parents.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): a merge of concurrent operations, or the root operation.

jj.ops.refused.shape.defaultMessage: jj recorded it in a form Combwork can’t read whole.
jj.ops.refused.shape.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): the operation’s view isn’t exactly what the tested jj writes. Keep jj.

jj.ops.refused.stale.defaultMessage: the project folder’s workspace is stale. jj workspace update-stale updates it, but edits jj hasn’t recorded can end up in a separate commit.
jj.ops.refused.stale.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): the project folder’s files are behind its working-copy commit. Keep jj workspace update-stale (a command).

jj.ops.refused.tool.defaultMessage: jj isn’t the version Combwork is tested with.
jj.ops.refused.tool.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800). Keep jj.

jj.ops.refused.unimported.defaultMessage: Git has changes jj hasn’t recorded yet (a branch, a tag or HEAD moved with git): your jj command would take them in first. Run any jj command, then preview again.
jj.ops.refused.unimported.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): the colocated Git repository’s refs or HEAD differ from what jj last recorded. Keep jj and Git, git and HEAD.

jj.ops.refused.workingCopy.defaultMessage: it changed a workspace’s working copy: undoing it would update files there, which a preview can’t check.
jj.ops.refused.workingCopy.description: Why a jj undo preview gives no command (HI-2800): a commit, describe, new, snapshot, workspace added or forgotten.

jj.ops.snapshot.description: A badge on a jj operation that recorded a workspace’s files (a working-copy snapshot, HI-2800). Lower case.

jj.ops.tracked.description: A remote bookmark’s value in a jj undo preview (HI-2800): its commit and whether it is tracked. Lower case.

jj.ops.why.changed.description: Later work in a jj undo preview (HI-2800): something the operation changed was changed again since.

jj.ops.why.descendant.defaultMessage: Commit {commit} was made on top of what it made: undoing it would rebase that commit
jj.ops.why.descendant.description: Later work in a jj undo preview (HI-2800).

jj.ops.why.restored.defaultMessage: Commit {commit} it hid is back since
jj.ops.why.restored.description: Later work in a jj undo preview (HI-2800).

jj.ops.why.rewritten.defaultMessage: Commit {commit} it made was rewritten or abandoned since
jj.ops.why.rewritten.description: Later work in a jj undo preview (HI-2800).

jj.readFailed.description: A jj section couldn’t be read (HI-2799). {error} says why.

jj.reading.description: While a jj section of the Version Control tab is read (HI-2799).

jj.refresh.description: A button in a jj section of the Version Control tab (HI-2799): reads it again.

jj.repo.colocated.defaultMessage: {colocated, select, yes {Colocated with Git: Git sees the same history.} other {Not colocated with Git.}}
jj.repo.colocated.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): whether a .git is beside .jj. Keep Git.

jj.repo.edits.defaultMessage: jj has no uncommitted changes: edits are recorded in the working-copy commit when jj snapshots them.
jj.repo.edits.description: A note in the jj Repository section (HI-2799), in place of Git’s Changes. Keep jj.

jj.repo.here.description: A badge on the jj workspace that is the project folder itself (HI-2800). Lower case.

jj.repo.op.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): jj’s current operation (its id, short), which every view is read at.

jj.repo.root.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): the repository’s folder.

jj.repo.stale.description: A badge on a jj workspace whose files are behind its working-copy commit (HI-2800). Lower case.

jj.repo.staleTip.defaultMessage: Its files are behind its working-copy commit: another workspace rewrote it. jj workspace update-stale updates them, but edits jj hasn’t recorded can end up in a separate commit: look before you run it. Combwork doesn’t run it.
jj.repo.staleTip.description: Tooltip of the stale badge on a jj workspace (HI-2800). Keep jj workspace update-stale (a command).

jj.repo.unsupported.defaultMessage: Not supported with jj in Combwork
jj.repo.unsupported.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799): what Combwork doesn’t do or support with jj. Keep jj.

jj.repo.version.description: The jj Repository section (HI-2799): the jj version Combwork uses. Keep jj.

jj.repo.workspace.description: A jj workspace in the Repository section (HI-2799): its name and its working copy’s change id and commit id (short).

jj.repo.workspaces.description: A heading of the jj Repository section (HI-2799): jj’s workspaces (working folders) of this repository, Combwork’s slots among them.

jj.row.change.description: A column of jj’s History (HI-2799): the change id (stable across rewrites).

jj.row.commit.description: A column of jj’s History (HI-2799): the commit id (this exact version).

jj.row.noDescription.description: A jj commit with an empty description (HI-2799).

jj.unknown.heads.defaultMessage: jj’s operation log has {detail} heads: Combwork reads nothing until jj reconciles them (any jj command in a terminal does).
jj.unknown.heads.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): jj’s operation log diverged (or can’t be read). {detail} is how many heads, or “unreadable”. Keep jj.

jj.unknown.moved.defaultMessage: The repository changed while it was read: refresh to read it again.
jj.unknown.moved.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): jj recorded an operation while Combwork read.

jj.unknown.noRepo.defaultMessage: No jj repository was found here.
jj.unknown.noRepo.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): the project folder has no jj repository (any more). Keep jj.

jj.unknown.other.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799). {code} is a short code for why, kept in English, with jj’s own words after it. Keep jj.

jj.unknown.tool.defaultMessage: jj isn’t installed, or isn’t the version Combwork is tested with, so nothing is read through it.
jj.unknown.tool.description: A jj section can’t be read (HI-2799): the jj tool. Keep jj.
